# Upstream SBOM fixtures

These files retain the original upstream bytes. Filenames here differ for clarity. Do not edit upstream fixtures; add separate synthetic fixtures for modified cases. Retrieved 2026-10-03. Tests do not resolve remote schemas, contexts, referenced documents, or component URLs.

## Shape and intended coverage

- `cyclonedx-1.7-evidence.json`: CycloneDX 1.7; two top-level Maven components with explicit versioned PURLs and component evidence. Exercises positive identity extraction. Evidence metadata must not override declared component identity.
- `cyclonedx-1.7-identifiers.json`: one component supplies CPE and Maven PURL. The standard allows this; the conservative inventory boundary may require reconciliation/review. Do not remove identifiers to force acceptance.
- `cyclonedx-1.7-assembly.json`: nested component assembly and separate nested services, without strong package identifiers. Exercises nesting and review, not invented PURLs.
- `spdx-2.3-example.json`: SPDX-2.3, four packages. The glibc version 2.11.1 package contains a spring_framework CPE version 4.1.0; preserve and reject/review the contradiction. Jena has an explicit Maven PURL. Other fields include absent versions and arbitrary external-reference types. Standards conformance does not establish acceptable inventory identity.
- `spdx-3.0.1-example13.json`: official compact context and CreationInfo version 3.0.1, despite upstream directory spdx3.0. Fifteen graph nodes include four software_Package nodes. All have versions, none has explicit PURL/CPE. One has an OTHER URL and one represents a container image. Exercises graph/context/local references and review without inferring identity from URLs/image names.

## CycloneDX 1.7 external-component distinction

The [pinned schema](https://github.com/CycloneDX/specification/blob/1ce97b2a7b8cf2429da248560d2aa671c6bce74a/schema/bom-1.7.schema.json) defines boolean `isExternal`, default false, for an environment-provided component outside the assembly, independently of scope. There is no external component type. Scope is required, optional, or excluded; absent scope defaults to required. Excluded covers test/nonruntime components; optional components are not installed or otherwise accessible. `versionRange` requires `isExternal=true` and cannot coexist with `version`. An external requirement needs separate observation evidence before representing installed software.
